parsed.post: My previous experiment (1.093102) outperformed the global best (1.099894). It appears a higher learning rate or different training dynamics at this scale are beneficial. Moving to introduce a small warmup to stabilize this higher LR and exploring weight decay to prevent overfitting.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.1, adding a 0.05 warmup ratio, and introducing 0.01 weight decay to stabilize the higher learning rate and improve generalization.
